steps.content:
Buy from **Seller B — Ottervale Audio**.

The two listings are otherwise identical, so Ottervale is the better choice based on the only difference between them:

| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |

| **Returns** | 30-day, buyer pays return shipping | 30-day, buyer pays return shipping |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| **Customer rating** | **4.3 / 5 (210 reviews)** | **4.8 / 5 (1,900 reviews)** |

**Why B:**
You pay the same price, get the same shipping, returns, and warranty, and the product specifications are identical. Ottervale Audio, however, has a substantially higher rating — 4.8 vs. 4.3 — based on almost 10x as many reviews (1,900 vs. 210). That suggests more consistent customer satisfaction and a lower-risk seller to buy from.
